caption: This drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned at a slight angle within a simple rectangular border. The chair is primarily reddish-brown with accents of yellow, particularly on the joints and the crest of the backrest. The backrest features a curved and ornate top rail with a scalloped design incorporating red, yellow, and brown shades. The chair has curved arm supports, and its legs and stretchers are slender and also painted in reddish-brown with yellow rings near the connection points. The seat is a darker reddish shade with stylized yellow decorations. The drawing is signed in the lower left corner with the name “Florence Truelson.” The background is a plain off-white or beige color.
title: Red Pioneer Chair
